 Machine-assisted analysis via DharmaNexus shows substantial Pali-internal formulaic reuse across 29 matching passages in eight other texts [DharmaNexus]. Its most frequent reuse partner is the first volume of the commentary to the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, 14 matches, including §4.1–5.3), as well as a homonymous Apadāna, the *Sūcidāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 79), which shares an identical passage across §4.2–7.1 [DharmaNexus]. Other recurring verse segments (principally across §§4–7) are shared with various other Therāpadāna poems, including the *Pallaṅkadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 152), *Sakosakakoraṇḍadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 356), *Kilañjadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 236), *Nisseṇidāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 174), *Isimuggadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 187), and *Pānadhidāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 214) [DharmaNexus]. Beyond Pali, DharmaNexus also identifies low-scoring algorithmic text alignments with the Sanskrit *Mahāsudarśanāvadāna* (11 matches, e.g., §2.4–3.2) [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
